column1: # A8 peer workspace cases (spec #683, ticket #684), read by a8-peers.sh. Tab-separated:
# workspace, consumer function (the third part of its site), field (contract or via), answer
# key, state, link, what 1.2.0 prints, case. State: control (the answer key and the base
# binary), landed (the spec), pending (the spec once its A8 ticket lands; until then it must read
# as the 1.2.0 column and does not count). Link: - when #683 names none, else the one link the
# consumer must have: provider repository, level (* any), then text its reason must hold.
# The ticket that lands a flow turns its rows from pending to landed in the same PR.
